title: The Biological Diversity (Amendment) Rules, 2025
authority: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change
section_title: Procedure for obtaining a certificate of origin for cultivated medicinal plants.
text:
[The Biological Diversity (Amendment) Rules, 2025 | PART II-Section 3-Sub-section (i) | Section 19 Procedure for obtaining a certificate of origin for cultivated medicinal plants. (1)]
(1) Books containing the details of cultivated medicinal plants shall be maintained by the Biodiversity
Management Committee in Form 11 in the web portal.

title: The Biological Diversity (Amendment) Rules, 2025
authority: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change
section_title: Procedure for obtaining a certificate of origin for cultivated medicinal plants.
text:
[The Biological Diversity (Amendment) Rules, 2025 | PART II-Section 3-Sub-section (i) | Section 19 Procedure for obtaining a certificate of origin for cultivated medicinal plants. (2)]
(2) An application for obtaining certificate of origin under sub -section 2 of section 7 of the Act shall be made to
the Biodiversity Management Committee along with the fee in Form 11A on web portal.

title: The Biological Diversity (Amendment) Rules, 2025
authority: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change
section_title: Procedure for obtaining a certificate of origin for cultivated medicinal plants.
text:
[The Biological Diversity (Amendment) Rules, 2025 | PART II-Section 3-Sub-section (i) | Section 19 Procedure for obtaining a certificate of origin for cultivated medicinal plants. (3)]
(3) On the basis of the entries made in the books maintained under sub -rule (1), the certificate of origin shall be
generated in the web portal in the Form ‘12’.
3.         In the First Schedule of the said rules, for serial number 11 and 12 and the entries relating thereto, the
following serial number and entries shall be substituted, namely: -
"Sl.No. Purpose of the Application Fee
11 Books containing details of cultivated medicinal plants, to be maintained by the Biodiversity
Management Committee in web portal
Nil
11A Application for obtaining certificate of origin for cultivated medicinal plants  ₹ 200
12 Certificate of origin issued to the applicant Nil"
4.         In the Second Schedule of the said rules, for the Form-11 and Form-12, the following Forms shall be
substituted, namely: -
